sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Lakshmi Kant Sharma  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Madan Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA
ORAL ORDER 7 18-04-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Hajipur Town P.S. Case No. 593 of 2021 registered for the offence under sections 498A, 341, 323, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
By order dated 08.02.2023, this matter was sent to the mediation center for settlement of the dispute between the parties.
The final mediation report is received and is kept at D.
perusal of the report shows that the dispute between the parties have been amicably settled on the terms and conditions attached therewith.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64249 of 2021(7) dt.18-04-2023 report of the mediator, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Vaishali at Hajipur in connection with Hajipur Town P.S. Case No. 593 of 2021 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Arvind Srivastava, J) mcv/-
